The '''Kuudra Relic''' is a {{Special}} Quest Item for obtaining {{Item|Kuudra Follower Leggings}}.

== Obtaining ==
The '''Kuudra Relic''' can be obtained following the steps:
*Click the bookshelf at {{coordinates|10|127|-938}} on [[Crimson Isle]] with over {{stat|int|4000}}. Doing so will give the following message: {{rmt|&aYou use your mana to pull a book out. Most of it is unreadable but you do notice a 2 and a 22...}}
*Right-Clicking {{coordinates|-373|82|-880}} inside {{zone|Blazing Volcano}} on [[Crimson Isle]] with any [[Drill]] during a {{Volcano Activity|Cataclysmic}} volcanic eruption, a menu opens for claiming the '''Kuudra Relic'''. The player must reach the {{Item|Heart of the Mountain}} level requirement of the drill.

== Usage ==
The '''Kuudra Relic''' can be brought to [[Kuudra Archeologist]] to obtain {{Item|Kuudra Follower Leggings}}.

== Trivia ==
*{{coordinates|-373|82|-880}} is obtained from the formula <math>\int 2x - 2x^5 + 7x^3 dx</math> [[Kuudra Archeologist]] has given with "2" and "22" input into bounds (<math>\int_{2}^{22} 2x - 2x^5 + 7x^3 dx</math>).
*Despite the name containing "Relic", which is usually used by 4th tier [[Accessories]] (For example {{Item|Titanium Relic}}, {{Item|Candy Relic}}), it is not an accessory.
*This item uses the same texture as {{Item|Fire Talisman}}.
*This item will not be consumed upon claiming the armor piece.
